algorithm_name: P2 closed tree packets before remote joins
method_description: Preserve guarded tree_frontier packets and owner; stable partition each core order into all closed packets then skeleton. One deterministic candidate; zero online evaluator calls.
case_selection: Same062 k2/4/5 as frozen tree pilot; isolated ordering intervention based on fixed-FIFO bound and existing trace. Selected development cells, no holdout.
failure_policy: First unsuccessful cell, unknown outcome, observer error, timeout, RSS violation or survivors stops the aggregate six-cell driver; no retries.
resources: One localmacOS worker after P1 releases; independent P2 mechanism experiment, not part of adaptive500. Aggregate300s, sampled4GiB RSS; noColab.
offline_costs: 6 synthetic tests and3 static graph checks reported separately, existing locked environment; zero training or online score tables.
comparison: Paired against exact previous tree data d15f27fe3ad41be63c9e837af0a7afae440eca66. Retain no-change/negative cells as controls; no old E0 rerun or threshold/owner changes.
